branch.prBase: legion/INFRA-439 until #2228 merges; GitHub retargets to main (delete_branch_on_merge is true), then merge main into the branch per the retarget rule
branch.readyGate: READY only once the pull request's base is main and #2228 is merged

summary: ensureStreamWithConfig builds every update from the deployed config and overlays only Subjects, MaxAge, Duplicates, Replicas = max(deployed, setting), MaxBytes (setting when set, else deployed), Discard = DiscardOld, Metadata as #2228 keeps it; the early return also compares Replicas, owned MaxBytes and Discard.

EnsureKeyValue raises an existing bucket whose KV_<bucket> stream has fewer copies than config.Replicas, by UpdateStream of the deployed stream config with only Replicas changed; covers all five buckets.
bucketPermissions gains $JS.API.STREAM.UPDATE.KV_<bucket> (listener, host, Dispatch grants; tests; gcp cloud-config goldens; infra README).

ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS (1..5, refused otherwise) read by the listener and by Dispatch (settings row; server ConnectOwningStream; redeliver.OpenState in server and redeliver-webhooks); aws rendering and render refuse > 5.
ENVOY_STREAM_MAX_BYTES (positive bytes) read by both programs; unset creates no limit and keeps the deployed one; server refusals name the variable and value.

Sizing measured from a core subscription to notifications.> (stream subjects only) over >= 1 h, Dispatch share scaled to INFRA-514's 4 events/s shape, x10 x 259,200 s; memory per retained message-id and disk per server reported; table in the PR and numbers to the architect.
#2228's gap notice text ('older than 72 hours') reworded in envoy-client, pi-envoy, claude-envoy (src + dist) to name the age or size limit; #2228's implementer told over Envoy.

Tests on a new in-process three-server testnats cluster (acceptance lines 3a-3l); production-like proof P1-P3 with real envoy-listener and envoy-dispatch binaries against three nats-server v2.15.1 processes (go run) read with natscli v0.5.1; negative control: replicas 3 against one standalone server refuses naming ENVOY_NATS_REPLICAS=3.

findings.finding: EV-1 / INFRA-514 architecture-review.md does not exist, and 'ten-times load' has three readings (today's rate, tonight-scaled, INFRA-514's 40 events/s target).
findings.answer: Plan defines the rate itself with the spec's own definition: >=1 h measured stream-subject bytes, Dispatch share scaled by f = max(1, 4 / measured Dispatch events/s) to INFRA-514's tonight shape, x10 x 259,200 s; PR table; recorded as a spec departure (source only).

findings.finding: Nobody owns Theorem's byte-limit and replica values; core.ListenerConfig, gcp:NatsHub, host:Listener and INFRA-549's component render neither; differing values would ping-pong.
findings.answer: Unset byte limit keeps the deployed one, so only setters matter; coordination item 1 to the architect recommends the child that raises replicas to 3 at the move sets the byte limit too, and INFRA-549/550 accept or leave it unset.

findings.finding: The grant change rewrites the VM's cloud-config (replaces the VM), overlaps #2228's permissions.go edit, conflicts with INFRA-551's no-replacement preview, and INFRA-549's hub needs it.
findings.answer: Stacked on #2228 so no file conflict; coordination item 2: merge before the envoy-infra release INFRA-553 step 1 applies, so one replacement carries both; live negative-control test 3l.

findings.finding: Old binaries (desired := *cfg) scale the stream back to 1; the move restores at R3 while settings are 1.
findings.answer: Decision 3 never lowers (max); coordination item 3 makes every ConnectOwningStream caller carry this change before the restore a precondition of the move.

findings.finding: #2228's notice says 'messages older than 72 hours may be missing', false once the byte limit binds.
findings.answer: Decision 9 / task 7: reword in envoy-client, pi-envoy, claude-envoy src and dist, tests and CHANGELOGs in this PR; tell #2228's implementer.

findings.finding: The 72 h duplicate window, the 'retention equals duplicate window by construction' statements, and per-message-id memory at 10x load.
findings.answer: Task 6 measures memory per retained message-id in-process and reports memory per server; task 8 rewrites the three statements (AGENTS.md, stream.go comment, contracts dispatch-api.ts); coordination item 4 leaves shortening the window to the architect.

findings.finding: Durable consumers set no Replicas; do they follow a raise?
findings.answer: Read nats-server v2.10.29 jetstream_cluster.go:6480-6490: Replicas 0 durables auto-scale with the stream; acceptance 3d asserts each durable reports 3 replicas after a raise.

findings.finding: A refused create/raise stops the start; drains, concurrent raises and raises under publish load are unverified.
findings.answer: Decision 8 keeps fail-on-refusal; tests 3i (publish during raise, two concurrent raisers) and 3j (one server down: steady state no-op succeeds, new create at 3 fails naming the setting).

findings.finding: Tests link nats-server 2.10.29, the hub runs 2.15.1 (metadata keys, decoded fields).
findings.answer: Production-like proof P1-P3 runs three nats-server v2.15.1 processes via go run; the no-op check never compares whole Metadata.

findings.finding: No byte-limit default leaves default deployments unlimited.
findings.answer: Decision 7: deliberate, because a sized default above the VM's reservable store would stop Dispatch and the VM listener at boot; Theorem's value is set at the move (coordination item 1).

findings.finding: 'From the Dispatch server' is ambiguous (bus call vs envoy-dispatch boot).
findings.answer: Decision 10: one options builder per program used by main and tests; the envoy-dispatch boot is smoke P3.

findings.finding: Missing checks: MaxBytes/DiscardOld on create, out-of-range settings, redeliver-webhooks, raised bucket keeps every field, the five buckets named.
findings.answer: Acceptance 3e, 3f, 3g, 3k; task 4 covers redeliver-webhooks; aws rendering/render refuse > 5.

findings.finding: .dispatch/architecture/envoy-listener.md says nothing about copies, so 'update it' is uncheckable; real one-copy statements are elsewhere.
findings.answer: Task 8 adds the sentence to envoy-listener.md and lists every one-copy statement found (scout inventory); docs acceptance is the parent's grep plus the reviewer's read.

findings.finding: Disk sizing needs stream limit plus KV plus Raft headroom.
findings.answer: Task 6 reports disk per server = byte limit + measured KV bytes + Raft headroom.

findings.finding: Unsourced claims: delete_branch_on_merge, #2228 head, server behaviour.
findings.answer: Verified: gh api repos/sjawhar/legion delete_branch_on_merge true; #2228 head 067a15af after fetch; nats-server v2.10.29 source read at stream.go:418, jetstream.go:2254-2285, jetstream_cluster.go:6403-6490.

specDepartures.spec: Size the byte limit from dispatch://INFRA-514's ten-times load (its finding EV-1, in INFRA-514's architecture-review.md).
specDepartures.plan: Measure the stream-subject message and byte rate from a worker pod's core subscription over >= 1 h, scale Dispatch's share to INFRA-514's 4 events/s shape, x10 x 259,200 s, and record the arithmetic in the PR.
specDepartures.evidence: On 2026-10-27 INFRA-514 holds only spec.md and dispatch-architecture-review-md, a Dispatch-server review with no EV findings; dispatch search for EV-1 finds only the INFRA-14 and INFRA-546 specs citing it. A 180 s probe from this pod measured 1.9 msg/s and 3.6 KB/s on stream subjects.
